blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — No crime incidents were recorded in cemeteries, columbaria and memorial parks across the Cordillera during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, the Cordillera police reported. In a statement following the Tuesday (Nov. 3) flag-raising ceremony at Camp Dangwa, Police Brig. Gen. Noel B. Vallo, Cordillera police director, said the highland provinces of Ifugao, Abra, Apayao, Kalinga, Benguet and Mountain Province and the City of Baguio maintained a generally peaceful and orderly situation despite the influx of visitors, tourists and families during the holiday weekend.
